reading.body:
Global DC OY is a plausible but unconfirmed Finnish data-center business, identified only by its name and an OpenStreetMap tag, with no verified capacity, operator, or website.

The record carries a Finnish limited-company suffix and "DC" in the name, which is the naming pattern real hosting and colocation firms use. That is the entire evidentiary basis. The facility sits about 24 miles from Helsinki Vantaa Airport, which places it in the capital region, the part of Finland where power and fiber are densest.

For AI specifically, this tells us almost nothing about available compute. A data center is a building, and buildings only matter to AI scaling through the power and cooling they can secure. This entry records no megawatts, no operator, and no confirmation the business still exists, so it cannot be counted toward capacity.

What the data does not cover is the substance: service offering, size, ownership, and operating status are all absent. The research note states that search quota ran out before any of it could be checked. Treat this as a lead for further verification, not as a facility on the map.
